candidates.about: The Kilties are an all-age co-ed drum and bugle corps rooted in Racine, Wisconsin. Founded in 1934, the organization evolved from a successful junior corps into an all-age weekend corps focused on music education, mentorship, and its values of character, honor, excellence, and tradition.

field_notes.location: DCI displays Racine, WI but lists an Oshkosh mailing address. Official Kilties text describes the corps as ambassadors of the Racine area and lists a Racine PO Box, so Racine is recommended for display.

candidates.about: Patria Drum & Bugle Corps is a Guatemala-based ensemble connected with Colegio Evangelico La Patria Occidente. The official school page describes the corps as including drum line, brass line, front ensemble, and color guard sections; it began as a banda de guerra in 1950, became a banda latina in 1990, and in 2003 became the country's first marching band.

field_notes.location: Official page uses Colegio La Patria Occidente identity and .gt contact; WGI source explicitly lists Patria Drum & Bugle Corps Guatemala, Quetzaltenango.
